title: Cast member
description: A character in the vaudeville cast. The cast — not the comic — is the unit of value: comics, videos, site headers, avatars and stickers are all renderers that consume these.

id.description: Must match the cast/<id>/ directory name.

name.description: Display name as it appears on the sheet banner.

role.description: One line on who they are in the world.

tokens.description: The verbatim description injected into every render prompt. This is the words half of identity; the sheet is the pictures half. Both are needed — the sheet carries silhouette and costume, the tokens stop the model inventing a different design when reference conditioning is weak.

sheet.description: Canonical turnaround sheet filename, relative to cast/<id>/.

headshot.description: Canonical square avatar headshot filename, relative to cast/<id>/. Purpose-rendered — never a crop of the sheet. 1024x1024, subject centred with even margin, art bleeding to all four edges so consumers can crop to a circle or a square without losing the face.

props.description: Signature objects. Quote exact lettering, e.g. a white mug lettered "CODE FUEL".

accent.description: Palette exception, if any. The strip is sepia duotone; note here if this character carries colour.

public_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the sheet once published to sethgholson.com/cast/. This is load-bearing, not cosmetic: partner_generate's medias[].value REQUIRES a publicly-fetchable URL, so publishing collapses the upload_file + hand-built-graph dance into a single call.

headshot_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the headshot once published. Same load-bearing role as public_url — avatars get consumed by external services that need a fetchable URL.
